q: What carbon data do EU buyers ask Bhadohi carpet exporters for?
title: Bhadohi carpet exporters: EU buyer data
short: Carpets are not CBAM goods, but EU retailers need supplier figures for their own Scope 3 and reporting. Expect requests for your Scope 1 and 2 totals and a figure per square metre, built from yarn, dyeing, backing and finishing. Send figures with their records, not a certificate alone.
audience: Carpet and rug exporters in Bhadohi and Mirzapur selling to European retailers and importers

ul: Scope 1 and 2 totals with factors and year.
Footprint per square metre for main qualities.
Share of recycled or natural fibres.

p: Much hand weaving happens in village looms you do not run. Count their yarn and transport in your product figure even if their energy is small.
One dataset per year, with the method stated and estimates labelled.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
